newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Aluar in $300 mln aluminum expansion.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Aluar in $300 mln aluminum expansion.

text.p: Argentine aluminum refiner Aluminio Argentino SAIC (Aluar) said Friday it is launching a $300 million expansion to boost its annual output by 72,000 tonnes to 258,000 tonnes.
The expansion will be completed by July 1999 and addititional output will be powered by a 120 MW combined-cycle thermoelectric generator to be acquired by Aluar, the firm said.
Technology for the expansion will be provided by France's Aluminium Pechiney, Aluar said.
The extra output from Aluar's plant in Puerto Madryn, southern Argentina, will go entirely to export sales.
